info.title: LUB Auction API
info.description:
Backend API for the Lowest Unique Bid auction platform.

**Conventions**
- All monetary values are integers in minor units (santim for ETB) with an ISO-4217 `currency`.
- All timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC and generated by the server.
- Errors share one shape (`ErrorResponseDto`); `error` is a stable machine-readable code.
- Protected endpoints need `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.
- Any endpoint can answer `429 RATE_LIMITED` or `503 SERVICE_BUSY`; both carry `Retry-After` and are safe to retry.

fields: password must be longer than or equal to 8 characters

details.description: Extra context, e.g. validation messages or retryAfterSeconds

phoneNumber.description: Ethiopian mobile number. Accepted formats: +251911234567, 251911234567, 0911234567, 911234567. Stored as E.164.

password.description: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one digit.

email.description: Optional. Never used to sign in.

mustChangePassword.description: true after staff reset the password: call POST /auth/change-password before anything else.

refreshToken.description: Single-use JWT used to obtain a new token pair.
